map.PSA 密度 PSAD = 血清 PSA ÷ 前列腺体积；小于0.15 低密度、: PSA density PSAD = serum PSA ÷ prostate volume; below 0.15 low density, 0.15 to below 0.25 intermediate density, 0.25 and above high density (the density grade describes PSAD only and is not a biopsy indication). Biopsy decisions follow PSA absolute value, DRE/MRI and other findings. Age-specific PSA upper limits: under 50 years 2.5, under 60 years 3.5, under 70 years 4.5, 70 and above 6.5 ng/mL.

map.PSAD 与临床显著癌风险相关，但不同 MRI 结果和临床情境下的决策阈值不同；: PSAD is associated with clinically significant cancer risk, but decision thresholds differ by MRI result and clinical context. A single threshold cannot decide whether to defer or perform biopsy.
